name: Feature request
about: Suggest a module, screen, or capability
title: ""
labels: enhancement

---

**Which part of the product does this touch?**
For example POS, kitchen display, tables, QR ordering, billing/VAT, reports,
inventory, the marketing site. Check
[docs/cloudflare/FEATURE-CHECKLIST.md](../../docs/cloudflare/FEATURE-CHECKLIST.md)
and the known limitations in the README first: is it already there, or
already listed as not available on Cloudflare?

**What problem does this solve?**
A restaurant, café or kitchen operator's real problem, not just "it would be
nice to have".

**Proposed solution**
What you would build, at whatever level of detail you have. If it changes an
architecture decision (see
[docs/cloudflare/ARCHITECTURE.md](../../docs/cloudflare/ARCHITECTURE.md)),
say what changes and why.

**Languages and region**
Does it need Arabic text, right-to-left layout, Saudi VAT/ZATCA behaviour,
or other regional settings?

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about and why you didn't go with it.

**Additional context**
Mock-ups, links to similar features in other restaurant systems, etc.
